data.body:
Implemented and pushed for review as Gerrit change 1574 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1574).

DECISION: include scripts/ in the typecheck scope (not exclude it). Makefile's typecheck target is now `mypy src/rebar scripts`, with a comment on the target recording the decision and its rationale.

Error volume: widening the scope surfaced 15 mypy errors across 6 of the 47 files in scripts/ — check_raw_git_writes.py (7), plan_review_impact_distribution.py (4), and one each in capture_jira_fixtures.py, probe_rebar.py, check_complexity_baseline.py, t5c_calibrate.py. All 15 are fixed at the source. No per-module mypy override was added, no new '# type: ignore' — in fact two now-unused ignores were REMOVED from check_raw_git_writes.py once its opaque-argv sentinel became a real class (_Opaque) whose unions narrow under isinstance.

Two of the 15 were latent bugs, not just annotation debt: capture_jira_fixtures._truthy called .strip() on a 'str | None', and check_complexity_baseline._run_lock passed a possibly-None dict into lock_against_base because the 'base is None' guard sat inside only one branch of the if/else. The guard is now hoisted to cover both paths.

On ae96's structural concern: the sys.path bootstraps (9 files) needed NO change. pyproject's follow_imports = "silent" plus ignore_missing_imports already absorb them, and none of the 15 errors was an import error — so the packaging smell was not in fact a blocker for this ticket.

Also corrected the stale 'full library' / 'full src/rebar' type-gate scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml, which Makefile:1-2 declares are mirrored 1:1 with the Makefile.

New guard tests/unit/test_typecheck_scope.py (modelled on test_ci_actionlint_scope.py) asserts scripts/ stays in the recipe, plus a negative case proving the guard rejects a re-narrowed 'mypy src/rebar' recipe.

Gates: make lint exit 0, make typecheck exit 0 (490 source files), 128 related unit tests pass. LLM-Review +1 already recorded; awaiting Verified.
